architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Part A: direct CoverBlock construction with real block-inserted PcodeOp boundary pointers and the three Ghidra sentinels; Part B: locked Varnode::updateCover -> Cover::rebuild on synthetic def-use/CFG graphs built through production Funcdata APIs (newOp/opSetInput/newUniqueOut/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/addEdge/setInputVarnode/calcCover) plus one production Cover::merge call; no Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata; blocks receive deterministic creation-order FlowBlock indices as a precondition (BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001); ops receive BlockBasic::insert midpoint SeqNum orders via opInsertEnd (first op 0x800002, append midpoints per block.cc:2269-2284)
analysis_options.observation: Part A per case: endpoint identity pairs (b/e/i/order/0m) at each construction stage, contain sampled at uindex {0, each real op order, ~0}, boundary sampled at the same points plus the input sentinel; merge results include empty flag. Part B per case: per-op SeqNum orders and the complete Cover as ascending per-block index start-end endpoint identity pairs
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, membership, or endpoint normalization; both sides print the same identity-classified projection of the same observation fields

cases.a1_construct: empty construction, setBegin's stop-promotion side effect (stop==begin-sentinel promotes to end sentinel), one-piece contain/boundary samples
cases.a2_twopiece_construct: directly constructed wrap interval [6,2]: non-empty, wrap contain (b/2/6/e inside, mid outside), boundary 2 at start / 1 at stop
cases.a3_boundary_sentinels: begin-sentinel start must NOT report a defining point at uindex 0 (pointer-level start!=0 test of cover.cc:137); input-sentinel block reports 2 for both uindex-0 probes
cases.a4_merge_disjoint_wrap: disjoint branch of merge (cover.cc:175-181): one-piece [3,4] takes two-piece [6,2]'s stop producing wrap [3,2]
cases.a5_merge_internal4_wrap: internal4 path (ustart==0 with op2.stop==end sentinel) picks the other start, leaving [4,3] wrap
cases.a6_merge_setall: internal3+mutual-containment setAll (b-e) and equal-start mutual containment keeping the wider interval
cases.a7_intersect_quadrants: all four one-piece/two-piece quadrants of intersect (cover.cc:59-102): overlap 2, disjoint 0, touch 1, one/two gap 0, one/two touch 1, one/two interval 2, two/two 2
cases.a8_merge_empty_copy: merging into an empty block copies the two-piece endpoint identities wholesale
cases.b1_wrap_join_multiequal_reader: production rebuild: join-block MULTIEQUAL reading a same-block earlier-defined varnode wraps the stop to the marker (d-0m) and falls through cover.cc:584-599 to slot recursion filling the predecessor
cases.b2_wrap_then_contained_reader: a later ordinary reader at a higher order is contained by the wrap range [d,~0]u[0,0] and returns without extending
cases.b3_multiequal_tip_precise: addRefPoint MULTIEQUAL-tip discrimination via the OLD stop's marker identity (cover.cc:590-597): a second reader after a (Begin, MULTIEQUAL) cover recurses ALL predecessors, filling the untouched one
cases.b4_merge_wrap_internal: production Cover::merge unioning a one-piece [2,2] def-only cover with a rebuild-produced two-piece [3,0m] cover yields wrap [2,0m]

observation_schema.format: Thirteen fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus twelve case records
observation_schema.part_a: construction-stage endpoint pairs, contain/boundary sample vectors over uindex {b,orders,e,i}, merge outcome states with empty flag, intersect characterization per quadrant
observation_schema.part_b: per-op SeqNum orders and per-block endpoint identity pairs (b/e/i/order/0m) of the rebuilt or merged Cover

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-cover-twopiece-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of CoverBlock::start/stop and Varnode::cover through #define private public in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/cover.rs and src/merge.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again
